name: proto-handler-read-request-field
description: A request field only a handler reads is published live with via naming that handler's implementer record, because only the merge knows whether a client calls the RPC; the handler itself is a dead implementer, since the registration that converts it to the server interface is cut, and the field no handler reads is unreferenced.
pending: bindings.16: deadset-go searches from each dead implementer and publishes the consumers only those searches reach with via (GO5).
